theorems.name: JSP410Closed.arbitrarily_many_large_closed_components
theorems.statement: forall N : Nat, exists p : Polynomial Complex, p.Monic and HasLargeClosedComponents p (6/5 : Real) N

theorems.name: JSP410Closed.not_uniformly_bounded_closed_components
theorems.statement: not (forall d : Real, 1 < d -> exists B : Nat, forall p : Polynomial Complex, p.Monic -> not HasLargeClosedComponents p d (B+1))

component_definition: Exists injective C : Fin N -> Set Complex, every C i is an ambient connected component of closedLemniscate p and d < Metric.diam (C i)
